data.title: 神罚 · 海边木屋的落日余晖
data.description: 夕阳沉入海平面的暮光时分，海风轻拂私密木屋的白色纱幔。神罚身着深蓝色的挂脖比基尼，下身围着半透轻纱。她侧坐在藤椅上，双手交叠轻搭膝头，落日金红色的余晖在她湿润白皙的雪肌上流淌出耀眼的光泽，眼波流转间尽显迷人的纯真与动情。
data.location: private wooden beach cabana at golden sunset
data.action: sitting sideways on wicker chair in beach cabana, navy halter bikini, translucent sarong, golden sunset sunlight illuminating bare shoulders and skin, blushing smile looking at viewer
data.lighting: warm golden hour sunset rays streaming through sheer white curtains
data.promptProse: Inside a private beach cabana at golden sunset, Modernia sits gracefully on a wicker chair wearing a navy halter bikini and sheer wrap. Warm evening sunbeams illuminate her bare skin and silver hair as she turns with an affectionate blush.
data.animaCaption: Modernia in a navy bikini bathed in golden sunset light inside a beach cabana.
